s1.text: Home page first draft. [Brackets] = details to confirm: email, bin sizes/prices, towns serviced, photos. Photos are grey placeholders until we have real shots of our trucks, bins and crew.

s2.text: Zones kept as mapped (Al, 23 Nov). Prices inc GST, up to 7 days hire; hotshot 10% shown (never below minimum); extra days $15/$20/$25 (Al confirmed 24 Nov). No Bombala all-in examples published.

s3.text: Weights from Snowy Skips app dockets. Priced at council 2026–27 rates inc GST: general $270/t, building & demolition $320/t, concrete $99/t, green $95/t. On the day the landfill sets the category at the weighbridge (Al, 24 Nov).

s4.text: Skip Bins page draft. From-prices are Cooma inc GST. Sizes 2/5/8 m³ — confirm bin dimensions if you want them shown. Book buttons go to the booking flow once the platform is chosen.

s5.text: Equipment: small plant dry hire (pumps, saws, jackhammers, up to 12-inch chipper); loaders/excavators wet hire only (Al, 24 Nov). Rates by quote. Grey boxes = photos still needed (small plant, crew loading). Business hours still to confirm.

s_opt.text: Two style options for Al to compare with the current home page (left). A: full-width photo hero with dark overlay, orange buttons, dark header, green trust strip. B: clean white, big headline, rounded photo with a 'waste tracked' badge, pill buttons, stats row. Pick one (or mix) and it gets applied across every page.
